url.description:
`grpc://host:port` or `http://` = plaintext (h2c); `grpcs://` or `https://` = TLS.
A bare `host:port` is plaintext.

message.description:
Request message as JSON (proto3 JSON mapping). For client-streaming methods a JSON array
sends one message per element.

useReflection.description: Ask the server for its schema (gRPC server reflection v1, falling back to v1alpha).

protoFiles.description: `.proto` files (relative to the project root) used when reflection is off.

importPaths.description:
Extra import directories (relative to the project root). The files' own directories and
the project root are always searched; Google's well-known types are built in.

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (self-signed development servers).

deadlineMs.description: Call deadline in milliseconds (sent as `grpc-timeout`); 0 = none.

KeyValue.description: A name/value row (query param, header, form field). Disabled rows stay in the file.

SavedMessage.description: A named message preset shown in the composer.

oneOf.description: Sent as text; validated as JSON first.
Base64 in the file, sent as binary.

MessageFormat.description: How a composer message body is interpreted.
